Siddhinath Chatterjee

AI/ML Engineer

 8521790637

  sidrockstar.sr@gmail.com

 https://www.linkedin.com/in/siddhinath-chatterjee/

9 Bangalore, India

SUMMARY

AI/ML engineer with 5 years of experience driving the conceptualization, development and deployment of AI vision strategies and generative technologies. Spearheaded comprehensive AI solution adoption across diverse business units, delivering measurable impacts. Expert in large language models (LLMs), retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and predictive analytics, with robust skills in data engineering, cloud platforms, and scalable AI architecture design. Adept at leading teams, ensuring collaboration and prioritization to deliver efficient and impactful solutions.

EXPERIENCE

AI Engineer

Koch Business Solutions India Pvt. Ltd	08/2023 - Present	Bangalore

Led multiple GenAI initiatives, integrating LLMs, RAG, vector databases, and AI-driven automation, optimizing finance, sales, and operational workflows increasing/saving over {$4 million} in value. Guided clients through data-driven decision-making for optimized outcomes and increased sales performance.

Data Analyst

Koch Business Solutions India Pvt. Ltd	01/2021 - 07/2023	Bangalore

Led analytics projects in plant optimization, financial solutions, and model monitoring. Served as primary POC for project management and client communication from project inception to delivery. Total project impact created {$10.8 million +} in value.

Associate-Visual Analytics Developer

Koch Business Solutions India Pvt. Ltd	07/2020 - 12/2020	Bangalore Enhanced project visibility by developing dashboards for {5} projects, resulting in improved decision-making and efficiency.

SKILLS

Generative AI

MCP, Semantic Kernel, Lang Graph, Prompt Flow, Prompt Engineering, Vector DB, Agents, Agentic Personas, Planners, Custom Tools/Plugins, Multimodal RAG, Responsible AI, Semantic Chunking, Indexing Pipelines, Hybrid AI Search, LLM Ops, AWS Bedrock

Cloud Computing & DevOps

Blob, EC2/VM, Glue, ML Studio, SageMaker, Lambda, Functions, RedShift, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFormation, ECR, ECS, API Gateway, CI/CD, Terraform, GitLab, GitHub, AML Pipelines, FastAPI.

Machine learning

Linear & Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Boosting, Bagging, SkLearn, PySpark, Transformers, PyTorch, TensorFlow, CNN, RNN, GAN's, AE's, VAE's.

Data Analysis

SQL, Python, Pandas, NumPy, NLTK, Spacy, Gensim, Seaborn, Plotly, Power BI, Tableau.

EDUCATION & INTERNSHIPS

Visual Analytics Developer - Intern Koch Business Solutions India Pvt. Ltd 01/2020 - 06/2020	Bangalore

Mechatronics Engineer - Internship

Creative Robotics

01/2020 - 01/2020	Ghaziabad

BE Mechanical

C.M.R Institute of Technology

07/2016 - 06/2020	Bangalore

PROJECTS

Guardian Technical Service Co-Pilot

05/2025 - Present	Bangalore

Chatbot for Guardian official website helping buyers with the perfect glass they can buy for their needs.

Tech Used :- Python, RAG, vector dB, Multimodel agent.

Impact :- Boosted client retention on website by 35%.

DocGen Agent

07/2024 - 04/2025	Bangalore

AI tool capable of generating relevant solution document for plant related issues by fetching information from Knowledge Base created by company's experts.

Tech Used :- Python, RAG, vector dB, AWS Bedrock.

Impact :- Reduced plant downtimes by 20 - 30%. Saved

approximately {$2 million} annually.

Compensation Plugin (HR-Ops)

03/2024 - 06/2024	Bangalore

AI tool providing Compensation benchmarking insights based on experience, skills, and region.

Tech Used :- RAG, LLM (GPT-4o), vector dB, Python.

Impact :- Lessened processing time by 50-60% and enhanced industry-wide compensation matching by 80-90%.

TnsGuru - AI Chatbot

08/2023 - 02/2024	Bangalore

AI chatbot trained on TNSI company data helping sales representatives to make effective & faster sales calls.

Tech:- Python, RAG, Semantic Kernel, Prompt flow, vector dB.

Impact :- Reduced sales call time by 35-45% and increased no. of sales per representative by 28%. Estimated value generated {$1.8 million} annually.

Falcon (Model Monitoring AI Tool)

06/2022 - 07/2023	Bangalore

A User login-based portfolio management tool allowing to onboard model monitoring AI recommended checks and monitor alerts through interactive dashboards.

Tech:- Python, AWS, GPT4o, GitLab, vector dB.

Impact :- By analyzing model performance and failures and generating alerts saved {$2.2 million} annually.

GLAD (General Ledger Anomaly Detection)

10/2021 - 05/2022	Bangalore

An enterprise tool to analyze financial data to catch discrepancies, helping the finance team with monthly close process and generate trend reports for leadership.

Tech:- SQL, Matillion, Redshift.

Impact :- Value impact of {$5.8 million} annually.

SMART Tool Development

01/2021 - 11/2021	Bangalore

An enterprise tool for MOLEX India, addressing complex scheduling of machines, inventory needs, raw material allocation and worker schedules.

Tech:- SQL, Python, AWS, Redshift, Fast API.

Impact :- Enhanced plant's operational efficiency by

{58%}, generating + saving {$3.5 million} annually.
